Thornburg Investment Management Inc Increased Teekay Lng Partners Lp (NYSE:TGP) Stake by $13.04 Million
May 7, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Thornburg Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Teekay Lng Partners Lp (NYSE:TGP) by 34.48% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Thornburg Investment Management Inc bought 766,774 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.99 million shares of the marine transportation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $53.53M, up from 2.22M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Thornburg Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Teekay Lng Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.42 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.42% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $17.83. About 32,244 shares traded. Teekay LNG Partners L.P. (NYSE:TGP) has risen 6.59% uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.96% the S&P500.
Thornburg Investment Management Inc, which manages about $94.41 billion and $13.26 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ctrip.Com International (NASDAQ:CTRP) by 2.13M shares to 2.66M shares, valued at $124.10 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 98,667 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 334,495 shares, and cut its stake in Casa Systems Inc ().
Thornburg Investment Management Inc is a New Mexico-based institutional investor with more than $94.41 billion AUM in July, 2014. This fund invests only a small percentage of its assets in equities and options. Thornburg Investment Management Inc is the 52th largest institutional investor in our database. Taken from Thornburg Investment Management latest Adv, the fund reported to have 195 full and part-time employees. Among which 37 performing investment advisory and research functions. The institutional investor had more than 11000 clients. Teekay LNG Partners L.P. (NYSE:TGP) Ratings Coverage
Among 5 analysts covering Teekay LNG Partners LP ( NYSE:TGP ), 1 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 20% are positive. Teekay LNG Partners LP has $24 highest and $18.0 lowest target. $20’s average target is 12.17% above currents $17.83 stock price. Teekay LNG Partners LP had 5 analyst reports since November 10, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Friday, November 10, the company rating was maintained by UBS. The stock of Teekay LNG Partners L.P. (NYSE:TGP) has “Neutral” rating given on Tuesday, February 13 by Citigroup. The stock has “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Monday, February 12. The stock of Teekay LNG Partners L.P. (NYSE:TGP) earned “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus on Friday, February 23. Jefferies initiated it with “Hold” rating and $18.0 target in Monday, December 18 report.
Teekay LNG Partners L.P. provides marine transportation services for liquefied natural gas , liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and crude oil worldwide. The company has market cap of $1.42 billion. The firm operates through two divisions, Liquefied Gas and Conventional Tanker. It has a 72.76 P/E ratio. It transports liquid petroleum gases, including propane, butane, and ethane; petrochemical gases, such as ethylene, propylene, and butadiene; and ammonia.
